## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
Example: "I'm frustrated when I try to use TOTP in a multi-tenant context because …"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Parity context

Does this feature already exist in `awesome-node-auth`?
- [ ] Yes – this is a parity gap
- [ ] No – this is a new capability
- [ ] Partially implemented (see parity table in README)

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or code snippets about the feature request here.
